head: 홈택스에서 미리보기 이용하는 방법
prompt: A Korean woman in her early 30s sits at a small wooden desk at home in the evening, typing on a laptop keyboard with both hands. The laptop screen is angled away from camera and softly out of focus, showing only indistinct blue-toned webpage blocks with no readable text. A warm desk lamp lights her face and hands from the left, creating soft shadows. Over-the-shoulder angle from behind her right shoulder, shallow depth of field, cozy home office setting with a mug of tea beside the laptop, realistic candid photography style, slightly grainy like a real smartphone photo.
alt: 여성이 집 책상에서 노트북으로 홈택스 화면을 확인하며 무언가를 입력하고 있는 모습

head: 지금 카드 사용 비중을 점검해야 하는 이유
prompt: Close-up top-down shot of a Korean man's hands spreading out several credit and check cards on a wooden table next to a small pile of paper receipts, sorting them into two loose groups. Natural daylight from a nearby window falls diagonally across the table, creating soft directional shadows of the cards. No visible text or numbers are readable on the cards or receipts due to shallow focus and angle. Shot from directly above at a slight tilt, realistic lifestyle photography, muted warm tones.
alt: 남성이 식탁 위에서 카드와 영수증을 정리하며 사용 비중을 점검하는 모습

head: 미리보기로 점검하면 좋은 절세 체크리스트
prompt: A Korean woman sits cross-legged on a living room floor with a small calculator and a notebook open on a low table in front of her, pen in hand mid-thought, a handful of receipts and a folder stacked beside her. Soft afternoon light comes through a sheer curtain behind her, gently illuminating the scene. The camera is positioned at eye level slightly to the side, capturing her thoughtful expression and the cluttered-but-organized table setup, with the notebook page left blank and out of sharp focus. Realistic home photography, natural color grading, candid mood.
alt: 여성이 거실 테이블에서 영수증과 계산기를 두고 절세 항목을 체크하는 모습
